text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, next up is a dumbbell shoulder
press to
build the deltoid—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer
<username>!
Nice
to see you!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, was I speaking out loud? Sorry,
haha...
choice_data_list: お疲れ様です。考え事ですか？

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking to change up Meek's training
regimen
a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume's body is a mass of
endless
potential. But if her training is
unbalanced, the
risk of injury is high.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
And I absolutely do not want Meek to
get injured.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Once I get back to my room, I'll
carefully reread
the Kiryuin family's
Trainer's Handbook for
insight.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Of course—self-discipline is one of the
basics,
after all! We have to set a good
example for our
trainees!
choice_data_list: あまり無理はなさらずに
『トレーナー白書』見てみたいです

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But as luck would have it, I never seem
to get
bags under my eyes, no matter
how late I stay up!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I won't cause my trainee
any
worry! So there's no need for you to
worry about
me either!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I calm the overly enthusiastic Trainer
Kiryuin
down, telling her that's not what
I meant.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's that?
You're interested in my
family's teachings,
Trainer
<username>?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I think your training methods are
splendid enough
as is, really...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But hearing you say that certainly
brightens my
day! I have one volume on
me that I can lend you
right now.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and just to let you know... there are
around
forty volumes in total. Shall I
bring the rest of
them for you tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I've basically memorized them, so you
can take
your time reading and return
them at your leisure!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
After all, I read them over every night as
part of
my bedtime routine! There's no
way I'd forget
anything written in them!
